Analysis1 indicated that there was no as- sociation between the use in the USA during 1976 of influen- za vaccines containing a swine virus component and the de- velopment of multiple sclerosis. Later analysis by the Immunization Safety Review Committee in the USA2 con- cluded in 2004 that the evidence favoured rejection of a causal relationship between influenza vaccines used in various years (including the swine vaccines of 1976) and relapse of multi- ple sclerosis but that the evidence was inadequate to either accept or reject a causal relationship with incident multiple sclerosis. 1.
